synthesizedFacts.fact: Smoking is an independent risk factor for premature facial wrinkling and facial aging.
Tobacco smoke contains chemicals that break down collagen and elastin, leading to sagging and wrinkles.
Smoking reduces blood flow to the skin, depleting it of oxygen and essential nutrients.
Quitting smoking can improve collagen levels and potentially reverse some skin damage.
The act of smoking, such as puckering lips, contributes to wrinkles around the mouth.
